title: Move boxes between three levels
summary: Sequence two lifts as two chains that run side by side and meet only at the shared transfer belt.
scope: Tests give deterministic native POSIX host evidence on a simulated plant scene; they are not physical, hardware, HIL, or certification evidence.
objectives: Describe each lift as its own chain of steps that loops back to its first step.
Start both chains with one transition and let them meet only at the belt between the lifts.

stages.title: Objective
stages.body: In src/ThreeLevelLifts.sfc.json, add the chain of lift B: B_LOAD, B_SETTLE, B_RISE, B_UNLOAD and B_LOWER, the same five steps as lift A one level higher.
stages.checkpoint: Each step sets every output of its lift, so reading the active steps tells you what each lift does.

stages.title: Predict
stages.body: Before running, follow one box: it rides the infeed onto lift A, A rises with its surface stopped, runs the box onto the transfer belt at level 2 and lowers; B does the same one level higher and hands the box to the outfeed.
stages.checkpoint: A lift moves only while its surface is stopped, a belt runs towards a lift only while that lift waits at its loading level, and Green lights once five boxes have passed EyeTop.

stages.title: Edit
stages.body: Correct this starter omission, save it, then run: The starter runs only lift A, so boxes pile up on the transfer belt; add the chain of lift B and start it from the same transition as lift A.
stages.checkpoint: The visible scenario must pass with saved host evidence.

stages.title: Run
stages.body: Press Check. ZPLC runs your saved program against the scenario of this lesson, with the plant answering your outputs, and lists every assertion that failed. To watch the plant move, press Run (F5) and open the 3D view.
stages.checkpoint: The required scenario is named three-level-lifts and contains {{assertions}} assertions.

stages.title: Observe
stages.body: Watch both lifts in the 3D view: they can move at the same time, and the transfer belt at level 2 is the only place where their chains meet.
stages.checkpoint: Neither lift moves while its surface runs, and no box is dropped.

stages.title: Reflect
stages.body: The EVENTUALLY assertion proves a box reached the top bin, the AT assertion proves Green is lit at the end and the ALWAYS assertion proves no box fell.
stages.checkpoint: The grade cannot see the order of the steps of each lift, nor whether a lift moved while its surface ran; it sees only what arrived and what fell. It does not establish physical lift speed, hardware timing, HIL, or certification.

hints.text: Copy the five steps of lift A and rename them B_LOAD to B_LOWER; lift B reads BAtLow, BAtHigh and BoxOnB, and sets BLoading instead of RunInfeed.
Start both chains with one transition: give the start transition a second target in toSteps, and keep the two chains apart from then on.

faultCases: The starter runs only lift A, so boxes pile up on the transfer belt; add the chain of lift B and start it from the same transition as lift A.
